question: Within a controlled, non-planar 3D generator, does unchanged RCLE R3 high response arise from periodic 6DoF camera self-motion, independently imposed image-quality degradation, or their interaction?
non_goals: modifying the R3 estimator, Sparse LK, support manager, 0.01/s threshold, causal three-pair rule, reset behavior or PairState
re-splitting or selecting the four ADVIO sessions after RCLE output access
running CoTracker or another reference tracker before this counterfactual
classifying natural-video responses as false alerts
claiming that normal gait is the natural-world cause
estimating obstacle, risk, recall, precision, AUROC, F1 or safety benefit
sequence16, Android, realtime, product or deployment integration

data_partitions.identity_basis: Four hash-bound ADVIO pose/timestamp waveforms and 20 block-specific deterministic scene seeds per block; each complete cluster contains all six arms.
Separate seed namespace CAL00..CAL03, deterministic frame positions, no RCLE estimator, response or trigger access.

Separate PREFLIGHT seed namespace on fixed ADVIO_14, the slowest of the four existing response-blind runtime references; eight complete 602-frame sequences, final access mechanics, no main or guardrail seed reuse.
Eight block-specific scene seeds in a separate GUARD namespace, each rendered in two clean source-known approach arms.

unchanged_algorithm_lock.synthetic_transport_requirement: A separately reviewed source adapter may provide generator-native K, timestamps and camera poses, but must prove pair-core numeric equivalence and may not alter R3 measurements or decisions.
unchanged_algorithm_lock.reset_rule: Any abstention, arm or sequence boundary, or pair at or below 0.01/s resets the streak to zero.
unchanged_algorithm_lock.pair_state: one fresh continuous PairState per sequence arm; no reset inside an arm

factorial_design.block_specific_seed_requirement: The same ordinal in different blocks is a different numeric seed and scene; all six arms inside one block/ordinal share the exact numeric seed and scene manifest.
pairing_invariants: Within a cluster, all six arms share scene graph, mesh geometry, depth surfaces, object identity, material source, lighting, intrinsics, timestamps, frame count and generator random streams.
Only camera trajectory differs by motion level.
Only the frozen quality operator differs by quality level.
No arm, scene, frame, cycle or seed may be replaced or selected after any RCLE output access.

periodic_path_construction: Interpolate source camera pose at the exact frozen frame timestamps using the already reviewed Temporal R1 pose interpolation.
Express every source pose relative to its first pose and map the continuous relative SE(3) path to a six-component Lie-algebra trajectory with nearest-previous rotation-log branch unwrapping.
Interpolate each component to a 60 Hz uniform grid, remove its least-squares affine time trend, and retain only the response-blind 0.7-3.0 Hz ideal FFT band.
Subtract the linear endpoint bridge in Lie algebra so the first and last residual twists are exactly zero, then sample back at the original frozen timestamps.
Set T_periodic(t)=T_ref*Exp(xi_closed(t)); set T_static(t)=T_ref for all t.
Apply no block selection, phase selection, amplitude normalization, time warp, clipping or output-dependent change.
common.interpretation: A finite endpoint-closed ADVIO-shaped periodic 6DoF intervention, not natural gait truth.

quality_interventions.firewall: Calibration may read rendered RGB, source-known geometry and response-blind image metrics only. It may not import, run, read or infer any RCLE response, trigger, support, feature-collapse or FB output.

metric_domain.input: paired 360x640 uint8 sRGB transport frames and their valid-geometry masks
metric_domain.linearization: For channel c=uint8/255, linear(c)=c/12.92 when c<=0.04045 else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4.
metric_domain.valid_mask: paired clean/degraded valid-geometry intersection; erode one pixel for 3x3 operators; no missing-pixel imputation
metric_domain.ratio_order: Compute degraded/paired-clean ratio for each frozen frame, then take the deterministic average-rank median of the 16 frame ratios. Do not divide aggregate medians.
metric_domain.subgroup_rule: The overall median and each of the eight block x motion subgroup medians must independently satisfy every target and cross-proxy gate.

response_blind_metric_definitions.variance_of_laplacian: Apply the fixed 3x3 kernel [[0,1,0],[1,-4,1],[0,1,0]] to float64 linear luminance with OpenCV BORDER_REFLECT_101; report population variance over the eroded valid mask.
response_blind_metric_definitions.multiscale_gradient_density: At sigma in {0,1,2} px, Gaussian-filter linear luminance with BORDER_REFLECT_101 and kernel 2*ceil(3*sigma)+1 (sigma 0 means no filter), then compute 3x3 Sobel gx/gy with scale 1/8 and magnitude hypot(gx,gy). For each paired clean frame and scale, freeze the clean valid-pixel 75th-percentile magnitude using linear interpolation; compute degraded and clean fractions strictly above that same threshold, average the three scale fractions, then form degraded/clean ratio.
response_blind_metric_definitions.local_rms_contrast: Partition the image into non-overlapping 16x16 tiles from the top-left. Keep tiles with at least 75 percent valid pixels. For each tile compute population std(Y)/(mean(Y)+1e-12), take the average-rank median over kept tiles, then form degraded/clean ratio.
response_blind_metric_definitions.source_known_edge_spread: CAL scenes and the analytic calibration fixture contain a response-blind plate with 32 fixed horizontal or vertical high-contrast step edges at middle depth. Sample linear luminance along each source-known edge normal at 0.25 px spacing from -8 to +8 px using bilinear interpolation; use [-8,-5] and [5,8] plateau means, orient low-to-high, linearly interpolate the first 10 and 90 percent crossings, and take their distance. Report the average-rank median width across valid edges and form degraded/clean ratio. This metric is CAL/fixture-only and is not required in main scenes.
response_blind_metric_definitions.invalid_metric_rule: A zero clean denominator, no valid tile or edge, missing threshold, empty valid mask, or any non-finite intermediate or ratio fails that seed/subgroup. It is never imputed, clipped or omitted.

blur.operator: isotropic Gaussian PSF in linear RGB at the 360x640 R3 working resolution, reflect border, identical sigma in all channels
blur.selection_rule: Choose the smallest candidate sigma for which the overall median and all eight block x motion subgroup medians satisfy both target and cross-proxy gates.

low_texture.operator: before rendering, contract each material's linear-RGB albedo texture toward its own mean by one global alpha; do not alter mesh, depth, lighting, exposure or camera path
low_texture.cross_proxy_guard: On CAL and analytic fixtures only, source_known_edge_spread_ratio_to_paired_clean must be within [0.90,1.10].
low_texture.selection_rule: Choose the largest candidate alpha for which the overall median and all eight block x motion subgroup medians satisfy both target and cross-proxy gates.

required_lock_contents: complete calibration seed/frame manifest and hashes
per-block and per-motion response-blind metric summaries
proof that no RCLE module or output was accessed

formal_main_manipulation_check.timing: After all 80 main scene manifests are frozen and rendered, but before any main-seed R3 import or execution.
formal_main_manipulation_check.frames_per_sequence: the same 16 frozen frame positions as calibration
formal_main_manipulation_check.scope: For each main cluster and motion level, compare the selected blur and low-texture arms with paired clean using the exact frozen metrics.
formal_main_manipulation_check.blur_sequence_pass: The 16-frame variance-of-Laplacian target ratio and local-RMS cross-proxy ratio both satisfy the frozen blur gates.
formal_main_manipulation_check.low_texture_sequence_pass: The 16-frame multiscale-gradient-density target ratio satisfies the frozen low-texture target; main scenes do not contain CAL plates, so edge-spread is not recomputed.
formal_main_manipulation_check.low_texture_no_blur_identity: The main low-texture arm must bind the exact independently reviewed albedo-contraction implementation hash and selected alpha, declare no PSF operator, and pass the quality-geometry identity gate. Any mismatch is INVALID rather than a manipulation failure.
formal_main_manipulation_check.block_gate: At least 18 of 20 main sequences pass for each of eight block x motion subgroups and for each degradation.
formal_main_manipulation_check.failure: INTERVENTION_NOT_EVALUABLE before RCLE output; do not recalibrate, replace a seed or expand the grid.

quality_interventions.no_fit_rule: No per-block, per-seed, per-arm or output-dependent strength is allowed. If either candidate grid has no valid global value, return INTERVENTION_NOT_EVALUABLE rather than expanding the grid in R2.

primary.name: fixed_denominator_three_pair_trigger_density
primary.definition: for each cluster-arm sequence, number of scheduled pair positions with the unchanged R3 compensated three-pair trigger true divided by that sequence's fixed 601 scheduled pair positions
primary.abstention: remains in the denominator and resets the streak; it is not imputed as an evaluable zero response

secondary.absolute_response: distribution and median of abs(compensated_expansion_median_per_s) among evaluable pairs only, always reported with evaluable coverage and never used for a terminal
secondary.known_cycle_locking: trigger-bearing cycle fraction, longest consecutive trigger-bearing cycles, and axial PLV of triggered-pair phase relative to the block's frozen response-blind phase component
tracking: forward-backward consistent track count and fraction

outcomes.forbidden_endpoint: Arm-relative top-20-percent high response is forbidden because it mechanically labels 20 percent in every arm and cannot estimate an intervention effect.

estimands.aggregation: Compute paired differences inside each complete scene-seed x motion-block cluster; average seeds within block, then average the four fixed blocks with equal weight.
estimands.interpretation_population: These four frozen ADVIO-shaped motion blocks and the deterministic generator scene distribution only.

bootstrap.scheme: Within each of the four blocks, resample 20 complete six-arm clusters with replacement. Use the same cluster resample for all nine terminal-driving contrasts.
bootstrap.overall_weighting: equal weight for each of four blocks
bootstrap.simultaneous_interval: For each of nine terminal-driving contrasts j, let theta_j be the observed equal-block estimate and s_j the sample SD of its 20000 bootstrap estimates. For replicate r compute z_rj=(theta_star_rj-theta_j)/s_j for every s_j>0 and T_r=max_j(abs(z_rj)). Let c be the type-7 linearly interpolated 95th percentile of the 20000 T_r values. The familywise interval is [theta_j-c*s_j, theta_j+c*s_j].
bootstrap.zero_variance_rule: A zero bootstrap SD yields the exact point interval only when all 80 observed unit-level contrasts for that estimand are identical; otherwise the analysis is INVALID. Any non-finite replicate or missing terminal-driving contrast is INVALID.
bootstrap.monte_carlo_receipt: Record bootstrap seed, replicate count, all nine theta and s values, type-7 critical quantile, critical value, interval bounds, software versions and an implementation hash.

effect_classification.SUPPORTED: overall point estimate >=0.10, simultaneous 95% lower bound >0, and at least 3 of 4 block point estimates are >=0.10 and positive

statistical_plan.multiplicity: The five mechanism contrasts, two interaction combination checks and two fixed quality-failure-union accompaniment contrasts share one nine-member familywise 95% max-t interval. Other flow, phase and failure metrics are diagnostics and cannot rescue a terminal-driving contrast.
statistical_plan.missing_data: A cluster missing any of six complete arms is incomplete and cannot be replaced. Analysis waits for deterministic resume or ends EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE; no complete-case seed substitution.
statistical_plan.sample_size_statement: 480 sequences are 80 independent paired clusters. The 20 seeds per block are a fixed minimum budget, not a power guarantee; no frame-level or cycle-level significance test is allowed.

measurement_fidelity.clean_trackable_pair: detected_feature_count>=60 AND forward_backward_consistent_count>=60 AND forward_backward_consistent_fraction>=0.50 AND median_forward_backward_error_px<=0.75 AND occupied_3x3_cells>=5
measurement_fidelity.clean_sequence_trackable: at least 70 percent of 601 scheduled pairs are clean_trackable_pair
measurement_fidelity.clean_arm_block_gate: for both STATIC_CAMERA__CLEAN and PERIODIC_6DOF_SELF_MOTION__CLEAN, at least 18 of 20 sequences are clean_sequence_trackable in every block
measurement_fidelity.quality_accompaniment_density: number of scheduled pair positions satisfying quality_failure_union_pair divided by the same fixed 601 pair denominator
measurement_fidelity.quality_accompaniment_supported: The preassigned STATIC degradation minus STATIC clean quality-failure-union contrast must be SUPPORTED by the same 0.10 point, 3-of-4 block and nine-member simultaneous lower-bound rule. BLUR uses BLUR_FAILURE_UNION_STATIC and LOW_TEXTURE uses LOW_TEXTURE_FAILURE_UNION_STATIC; no post-outcome metric choice is allowed.
measurement_fidelity.feedback_firewall: All measurement-fidelity and local-flow outputs are read only after the generator, quality-strength, implementation and analysis locks are immutable. They may not select scenes, strengths or arms.

local_flow_measurement_contract.coordinates: x=(u-cx)/fx and y=(v-cy)/fy; flow is divided by source-native pair dt
local_flow_measurement_contract.per_cell_model: robustly fit v(p)=A(p-c)+b independently in each fixed 3x3 image cell using the frozen LK-consistent tracks and no cross-cell borrowing
local_flow_measurement_contract.minimum_support: at least 8 tracks in a cell; otherwise all cell components are NA
local_flow_measurement_contract.radial_tangential: project flow onto unit radial and tangential basis about the principal point; radius below 0.02 normalized units is NA
local_flow_measurement_contract.no_imputation: NA cells and pairs remain NA and are not filled with zero
local_flow_measurement_contract.role: measurement and mechanism localization only; never a seed filter, strength tuner or R3 modification input

positive_guardrail.source_truth: strictly monotonic decreasing camera-to-target depth, at least 20 percent inverse-depth increase over the sequence, and median source-known radial expansion >=0.05/s
positive_guardrail.aggregation: For each guardrail arm and block, compute the arithmetic mean of the two seed-level fixed-601-pair trigger densities. The overall arm mean gives each of the four block means equal weight.
positive_guardrail.baseline_validity_gate: Each guardrail arm separately must have overall unchanged-R3 trigger density >=0.50 and at least 3 of 4 arm-specific block means >=0.50. One arm cannot rescue the other.
positive_guardrail.future_candidate_rule: Any later suppression candidate must preregister and retain at least 90 percent of the frozen R3 APPROACH_PLUS_PERIODIC_6DOF density in every block that passed the R2 0.50 block gate, and may not fall below 0.50 overall; R2 does not test a suppression candidate.
positive_guardrail.main_analysis_role: excluded from all five mechanism estimands

execution_states.INVALID: Any hash, pairing, algorithm lock, firewall, geometry, statistical-code or receipt mismatch. Close this evidence version only.
execution_states.EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE: Any frozen arm is incomplete. Resume only the same deterministic identity; do not replace a seed or analyze a subset.

decision_rules.INTERVENTION_NOT_EVALUABLE: Any required 3D geometry gate fails; no global response-blind blur or low-texture strength satisfies its frozen calibration grid; any formal quality manipulation check fails; either clean arm fails the clean-arm block gate; or the source-known positive guardrail fails.
decision_rules.MIXED: MOTION_CLEAN and at least one of BLUR_STATIC or LOW_TEXTURE_STATIC are SUPPORTED, or a positive interaction is SUPPORTED and its corresponding motion-plus-degradation versus static-clean combination check is also SUPPORTED.
decision_rules.MOTION_SUPPORTED: MOTION_CLEAN is SUPPORTED; both quality simple effects and both positive interactions are RULED_OUT_AS_MATERIAL; the clean-motion tracking gate passes. At least 3 of 4 motion-block point effects must meet the 0.10 threshold by the common SUPPORTED rule.
decision_rules.QUALITY_SUPPORTED: At least one quality simple effect is SUPPORTED with its corresponding quality-accompaniment failure metric supported; MOTION_CLEAN and both positive interactions are RULED_OUT_AS_MATERIAL. Report subtype BLUR, LOW_TEXTURE or BOTH.
decision_rules.NO_SEPARATION_HOLD: Every other complete and valid pattern, including an effect that is supported while a competing mechanism remains INCONCLUSIVE, or no effect that reaches the frozen support rule.

constraints.description: Every main analysis cluster contains exactly the six frozen arms with shared scene and random-stream identity.
The separately frozen geometry validator must report every required non-planar depth, parallax, projection, occlusion and pairing gate as passing before any RCLE output.
constraints.rationale: A planar homography cannot represent translation parallax or near/far differences and would not answer the self-motion question.
constraints.calibration_source: Source-known 3D geometry fixtures and all formal seed manifests, without RCLE output.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report every gate separately; do not lower a failed threshold or replace a seed in R2.
constraints.revision_policy: Frozen for R2; a different geometry design requires a new protocol version.

constraints.description: A supported mechanism contrast must increase fixed-denominator trigger density by at least ten percentage points.
constraints.rationale: The user selected a ten-percentage-point minimum as a practically material separation rather than a frame-level significance artifact.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome user decision and the fixed-denominator R1 trigger-density convention.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report continuous estimates and intervals; do not sweep 0.10 after outcome access.
constraints.revision_policy: Frozen before any R2 RCLE output; change requires a new version.

constraints.description: A supported contrast must reach the ten-percentage-point point-estimate threshold in at least three of four frozen motion blocks.
constraints.rationale: Prevents one ADVIO-shaped waveform from dominating the equal-weight overall result.
constraints.calibration_source: The four pre-existing response-blind motion blocks; none may be selected or dropped.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report all four block estimates; no pooled-only rescue and no block replacement.
constraints.revision_policy: Frozen before any R2 RCLE output; change requires a new version.

constraints.description: A supported terminal-driving contrast must have a nine-member familywise simultaneous 95 percent lower bound strictly above zero.
constraints.rationale: Controls all five mechanism, two combination and two fixed quality-accompaniment contrasts and prevents frame or cycle pseudo-replication.
constraints.calibration_source: Block-stratified paired cluster-bootstrap design with all six arms resampled together.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Also report ordinary intervals and raw block estimates; terminal uses only the frozen simultaneous interval.
constraints.revision_policy: Frozen before any R2 RCLE output; change requires a new version.

constraints.description: At least 18 of 20 sequences in each block must be trackable for each clean motion arm.
constraints.rationale: The counterfactual cannot separate mechanisms if clean periodic motion itself causes widespread measurement failure.
constraints.calibration_source: Temporal R1 response-blind tracking thresholds and a predeclared 90 percent sequence quorum.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report all sequence coverages; no imputation, seed replacement or threshold relaxation.
constraints.revision_policy: Frozen before any R2 RCLE output; change requires a new version.

constraints.description: The unchanged R3 must retain a material response to separately generated source-known monotonic approach before R2 can be used as a future suppression reference.
constraints.rationale: Prevents later motion suppression from appearing successful by suppressing genuine source-known approach response.
constraints.calibration_source: Existing sustained positive development response and source-known generator radial expansion of at least 0.05/s.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report every guardrail arm; guardrail does not enter the five mechanism contrasts.
constraints.revision_policy: Frozen before guardrail output; a different guardrail requires a new version.

constraints.description: No result can establish natural-data false alerts, gait causality, obstacle/risk performance, Android, product or safety authority.

core_fields_new_version_only: algorithm threshold or three-pair state machine

successor_policy.motion_supported: Design a separately reviewed background-flow, FOE and translation/rotation decomposition candidate; do not use a gait-frequency notch.
successor_policy.quality_supported: Only then design a separately reviewed quality-gate revision.
successor_policy.mixed: Design a two-stage motion-decomposition plus quality-rejection candidate; do not change one threshold.
successor_policy.hold: Stop this mechanism route; do not re-split these ADVIO sessions or enter sequence16, Android or realtime integration.
successor_policy.not_evaluable: Repair only the failed generator, calibration, transport or execution dependency in a new reviewed evidence version; do not interpret mechanism effects.
successor_policy.reference_tracker: CoTracker or reference-track diagnosis remains deferred until after R2 and may localize LK support versus motion-model limits, but cannot identify the causal intervention.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Four frozen periodic 6DoF motion blocks x 20 new block-specific 3D scenes x six paired motion-quality arms, plus disjoint response-blind calibration and source-known approach guardrails.
experiment_design.resource_budget: 480 main sequences, 80 independent clusters, 288480 scheduled main pairs, 16 guardrail sequences, no formal execution until the separate budget and guarded-host preflight pass.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop before RCLE output if geometry, blind calibration, implementation equivalence, analysis lock, independent review or resource preflight fails. After a complete valid run, accept exactly one frozen scientific terminal and do not tune or replace arms.
experiment_design.efficiency_strategy: Use deterministic regeneration and bounded staging instead of retaining all rendered frames; reuse the unchanged R3 core and four response-blind ADVIO pose shapes, but do not reuse their RGB outcomes as counterfactual evidence.
experiment_design.cartesian_justification: All six cells are required to identify two quality simple effects and two motion-by-quality interactions. This is the smallest complete factorial for the stated three-level quality factor, not a candidate sweep.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: R1 found strong pose periodic energy and broadly continuous flow direction, but no stable pose-frequency synchronization and no causal intervention.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Changes only an endpoint-closed 6DoF camera trajectory while holding scene and clean image quality fixed.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Identifies whether periodic self-motion alone materially raises unchanged R3 trigger density.
hypotheses.minimal_test: PERIODIC_6DOF_SELF_MOTION__CLEAN minus STATIC_CAMERA__CLEAN in all 80 paired clusters.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: MOTION_CLEAN support classification plus clean tracking fidelity.
hypotheses.falsifier: MOTION_CLEAN is ruled out as material or remains inconclusive under the frozen interval and replication rule.
hypotheses.resource_budget: Two clean arms inside the shared 480-sequence factorial.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not add a fifth ADVIO waveform, select a favorable block or change R3 after output access.
hypotheses.selection_reason: Directly intervenes on the mechanism that R1 could only observe.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: R1 high response only partially overlapped blur, feature collapse and FB failure; observation alone could not identify whether degradation causes response.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Applies a globally frozen response-blind blur or low-texture operator while holding 3D geometry and camera trajectory fixed.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Separates blur and low-texture simple effects from periodic-motion effects.
hypotheses.minimal_test: STATIC blur and low-texture arms versus their paired STATIC clean arm, with failure accompaniment diagnostics.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: BLUR_STATIC and LOW_TEXTURE_STATIC plus their preassigned STATIC degradation-minus-clean quality-failure-union contrasts in the common nine-member simultaneous family.
hypotheses.falsifier: Both quality simple effects are ruled out as material, or fidelity is not evaluable.
hypotheses.resource_budget: Three static-camera quality arms inside the shared factorial plus a response-blind calibration panel.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not tune strengths from RCLE support, response, trigger or failure output.
hypotheses.selection_reason: Directly intervenes on the alternative mechanism left unresolved by R1.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: A quality failure may only become consequential under self-motion, so simple effects alone are insufficient.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Compares the motion effect under blur or low texture against the clean motion effect using the same complete clusters.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Determines whether abnormal response requires the combination rather than either main route alone.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Two preregistered difference-in-differences contrasts and their motion-plus-degradation versus static-clean combination checks.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: MOTION_X_BLUR and MOTION_X_LOW_TEXTURE plus their two motion-plus-degradation versus static-clean combination checks in the common nine-member simultaneous family.
hypotheses.falsifier: Both positive interactions are ruled out as material.
hypotheses.resource_budget: Uses all six already-required factorial arms.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not add a combined blur-plus-low-texture factor in R2; that would require a new 2x2x2 design.
hypotheses.selection_reason: Completes the minimum factorial needed to avoid mislabeling an interaction as a main effect.

failure_learning.observation: R2 has not rendered a formal seed or produced any RCLE output.
alternative_explanations: R1 windows may be too short for observational synchronization
periodic pose may not be natural gait
R3 local flow may mix spatially distinct motion modes
blur and low texture may act through an interaction rather than a simple effect
the controlled generator may not reproduce natural-video failure modes
constraint_challenges: Twenty seeds per block are a fixed minimum budget, not demonstrated power.
Any pre-outcome precision failure must revise the seed count before formal output rather than rescue a completed run.

round_summary.new_facts_and_evidence: No new algorithm outcome. The design converts the R1 observational ambiguity into a paired controlled intervention with 80 analysis clusters.
round_summary.weakened_or_rejected_hypotheses: No mechanism hypothesis is rejected before R2 execution.
round_summary.unresolved_questions: Exact generator implementation, response-blind quality strengths, R3 transport equivalence, runtime qualification and formal outcomes remain unresolved.
round_summary.reusable_assets: R1 pose/timestamp identities, R3 composite lock, three-pair state machine, response-blind phase components and fixed tracking thresholds.
round_summary.next_high_information_experiments: Implement and independently validate only the generator geometry, blind calibration and runtime preflight; formal 480-sequence execution remains closed.
round_summary.governance_changes_needed: None. Existing development-stage and host guarded-run rules are sufficient.
